reviews.title: My computer is brighter than ever, and it's thanks to these fans!
reviews.comment:
I needed new fans for my PC after my Lian-Li fans' lights failed, and I decided to get these since the new QX fans were much too far out of my price range. These were perfect for the job, and even though these fans are wired, I could still organize the wire spaghetti quite well to keep them from looking too messy.
The fans are very quiet unless you're running them at maximum speeds, which doesn't really bother me at all. Anything I've really ever purchased from Corsair has been a durable product, so I haven't had to worry about the fans being of bad quality or anything. Airflow is great just because I run them at max speeds so they're always working at their best to keep my PC cooled down.
Definitely a good choice and a solid product!
reviews.author: Dylan Decker

reviews.title: Pretty fans for a pretty case.
reviews.comment: Truthfully, I got these because I got a Corsair AIO for a new CPU on a whim and wanted to have everything match. They're as quiet as you could hope for and price competitive. They move air as well as any fans in their class and with the app you can adjust speed. I have a Hyte 70 case and don't hear the fans really and everything seems pretty cool overall. Clipping them together is fairly handy, though cable management can be unusual, best to figure that out before you screw them down.
reviews.author: Dareshiranu

reviews.title: These are amazing.
reviews.comment:
I bough one of these a few years ago when they first came out. And fell in love with them.
I just bought this one a month or two ago.
Running an i9 and a 3080 with water cooling. Two radiators (380, and a 240)
Max graphics on demanding games, and 3d Modeling I run around 30-40 degrees combined CPU and GPU heat.
Absolutely quiet, and smooth,
The link system is a godsend for assembly and clean wire management. You literally just link them together like Lego's, or a single cable.
So that is the performance for the fan, for the aesthetics. these have just about every kind of lighting color, and pattern you can imagine. Though mine are just set to white using the time warp profile, which syncs the light with the RPM of the fan to make it appear as though the fans are not moving.
I'd buy more, but I'm maxed out on fans for the case. I still have room, but do not need more.
reviews.author: Carol L. Mccawley

reviews.title: Great Fans For Any Build
reviews.comment: These fans are extremely easy to install and work better than I could have imagined. These are great add ons to any build you might be making. Fan speeds, cooling, and overall airflow are amazing and super quiet.
reviews.author: Luke

reviews.title: Great fans!
reviews.comment: They are excellent fans, keeps everything nice and cool at a very pleasant sound level and they look great! Glad I decided to go with them!
